issue.title: Recipient completion in the Bob Mail New email modal from saved mail participants

task_type_fields.proposal: Suggest recipients in the Bob Mail "New email" modal (To/Cc) from participants of saved mail notes, served by bob (for example a completion or search source over the mail index) so the plugin stays a thin client of bob.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Deferred by plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 (epic bob-cli-hg). The compose phases shipped plain To/Subject entry; recipient completion spans a new bob read surface plus the bob-plugins modal and was explicitly left out of the epic.

issue.creation_reason: Filed by the bob-cli-hg land agent: plan:202611/bob_gmail.md §6 lists this as a deferred follow-up to file once the Gmail epic lands.

payload.description: Deferred follow-up from the Gmail epic plan §6; builds on what bob-cli-hg shipped
